login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: From your authenticator app. Lost it? Enter one of your backup codes instead.

errors.invalid: That did not match. Try again.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.notConfigured: Login is not configured (AUTH_SECRET missing, see README).
errors.deviceLimit: This account is already signed in on 2 devices. Sign out or revoke one in Settings on another device (or run `pnpm user revoke` on the home PC).
errors.notEnrolled: This account has no authenticator yet. Run `pnpm user reset-2fa` on the home PC.
errors.expired: The sign-in took too long. Start over.

add.title: Add
add.sourceSearchSoon: Searching SNKRDUNK and other sites comes in a later update.
add.noResults: No match. Use "New item" to create it.
add.costHint: Total paid for all units, including anything you want to count (e.g. shipping).
add.rawGradeHint: S: mint, A: near mint, B: light wear, C: wear, D: damaged.

errors.pickProduct: Pick an item from the search results.
errors.pickKind: Choose what kind of item it is.
errors.pickSet: Pick the set, or enter it manually.

add.setSearchPlaceholder: Search by set name or code
add.noSets: No matching set. Use "Not in the list" below.
add.notInList: Not in the list? Enter it manually

actions.partialHint: You have {total}. Choosing fewer moves them into a separate entry first.
actions.splitHint: Cost is divided in proportion to the units.
actions.openSealedHint: Once the packs are opened the box counts as consumed; its value lives on in the pulls.
actions.extraFeeHint: Upcharges or return shipping. Added to the cost basis.
actions.feesHint: Platform fee and shipping you paid.
actions.editCostHint: Correct the total paid. Use grading or sell for later changes.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry and its history. Only for entries registered by mistake; this cannot be undone.

intro.edit: Correct what was recorded. The change is kept in the history.
intro.split: Move some units into their own entry, e.g. before selling or grading only some of them.
intro.grade-submit: The fee is added to the cost basis. The card stays raw until it comes back.
intro.sell: Partial sales split the lot automatically.
intro.condition: Only the fields you change are recorded.
intro.editProduct: Applies to every entry of this item.

pulls.name: Card name
pulls.nameHint: Set, franchise and region come from the box.

events.acquiredSummary: {qty, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} for {cost}

settings.title: Settings
settings.collectorsInfo: Collectors run on your home PC (pnpm collect) and write to the database. Private collectors live in an optional submodule.
settings.devicesInfo: Each account can be signed in on up to 2 devices. Signing out or revoking frees a slot; a new device needs the password and an authenticator code.

errors.not_owned: Only items you still own can be changed this way.
errors.invalid_quantity: That quantity is not possible for this entry.
errors.not_sealed: Pulls can only come from a sealed TCG product.
errors.not_packaged: This item has no packaging state.
errors.already_at_grader: This card is already at a grader.
errors.not_at_grader: This card is not at a grader.
errors.has_dependents: Other entries depend on this one (pulls or splits), so it cannot be deleted.
errors.forbidden: Only the person who created this item can change it.
